subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw permanently retire the shipped `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` value now and migrate existing configurations as this PR proposes?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but choosing between retiring a shipped config contract and preserving it for future gRPC support is a compatibility/product decision that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve HTTP-only contract
options.body: Land the PR's validated schema narrowing and doctor migration, accepting that active legacy gRPC configurations may be disabled until reconfigured for OTLP/HTTP.

options.title: Preserve gRPC contract
options.body: Keep `grpc` accepted and pause this PR until a real gRPC exporter or a different staged deprecation path is approved.

recommendation.title: Approve HTTP-only contract
recommendation.body: Land the PR's validated schema narrowing and doctor migration, accepting that active legacy gRPC configurations may be disabled until reconfigured for OTLP/HTTP.
